title: NIST Juliet (Java)
description: 10 test cases from the NIST Juliet Test Suite for Java 1.3 (Software Assurance Reference Dataset, samate.nist.gov), one per weakness type (CWE), in its simplest form. Comments, names and other hints that reveal the flaw were removed before review.

cases.title: CWE-89 SQL injection
CWE-78 OS command injection
CWE-80 Cross-site scripting
CWE-23 Path traversal
CWE-259 Hard-coded password
CWE-327 Broken crypto (DES)
CWE-328 Weak hash (MD5)
CWE-369 Divide by zero
CWE-190 Integer overflow
CWE-476 Null pointer dereference
